headline: Violent protests erupt across France
standfirst: Demonstrations have turned destructive as buildings and cars are set on fire.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Protests across France have turned violent. Buildings were set on fire and shops were ransacked.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Widespread demonstrations have escalated rapidly, leading to disorder across the country.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: The scale of the destruction affects local businesses and raises concerns about public safety.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Watch for further reports on the spread of the unrest and government responses.

caption:
Violent protests break out across France as demonstrations lead to fires and looting.

Reports from the BBC confirm that peaceful demonstrations have devolved into chaos. Cars and buildings have been set alight in cities across the country. We are monitoring the situation as it unfolds.

How do you think governments should handle large protests that turn violent?
